bear_case: The dominant bear case for June 30 is structural, not sentimental. NVDA closed $194.97 on June 29 — $0.03 below the $195 mandatory exit threshold — on the best macro day of the 2026 correction cycle. The institutional distribution pattern above $195 that has absorbed three consecutive major catalysts (June 26 reconstitution, June 29 Samsung/SCOTUS, June 29 AI re-rating) is not a momentum pattern; it is active selling by entities with a known supply overhang. The forced exit today adds to that supply at the open. Meanwhile, FOMC June 17 hawkish pivot (Warsh, 3.80% median year-end rate, cuts pushed to 2027-2028) removes the rate-cut tailwind that drove the May recovery from $183 to $205+. The $165B quarter-end selling program (JPMorgan estimate) is concentrated today — the majority was absorbed on June 29 (Nasdaq +2.07%) but residual selling continues. If SPX cannot sustain a close above 7,460 today into the residual $165B selling program on a day when there is also NVDA forced-exit pressure, then the 7,300 bearish escalation level becomes the next decision point before NFP. BTC at $59,339 (−1.24%, Day 9 gate) confirms that cross-asset risk appetite has not fully recovered. SK Hynix stop nearly triggered (₩2,541,000 vs. ₩2,540,000 threshold) adds Korea-specific stress signal. Invalidation: SPX closes above 7,460 AND VIX closes below 17 simultaneously today — upgrade to BUY medium. Both gates clearing at Q2 close would mark the first full regime clearance since May 14 ATH.
